redThenGreen.scope: Return review before settlement preparation, before first send and during ERP response
Completion queue must exclude uncertainty on earlier payments for the same payable
Duplicate bank funds must produce a stable finance conflict and fully roll back

verified: Original success and fixed target remain queryable before or after settlement
External reads execute outside database transactions and require explicit registration
Current access, actor eligibility, displayed versions and fresh original bank facts are rechecked
Query expiry, lost responses and late workers cannot overwrite newer state
Audit or duplicate-funds failure rolls back the complete decision
Partial and full cumulative refunds preserve first registration ownership
Shared payable locks serialize concurrent return freezes and new requests
Unknown original bank evidence after completed settlement blocks another payment request
Actual ERP posting is retained when a return prevents local completion
remaining: Public return API and sensitive-field permission acceptance
Browser workflow and existing nonempty V79 database upgrade
Real enterprise integration and production acceptance
